faq.q: Does mortgage forbearance erase the missed payments?
faq.a: No. Forbearance temporarily pauses or reduces payments. Ask the servicer how the amounts must be repaid under the actual arrangement.

faq.q: Should I wait until forbearance ends to call my servicer?
faq.a: No. Contact the servicer before the arrangement ends to discuss repayment options and what a proposed sale would require.

faq.q: Can I use my normal statement balance as the sale payoff?
faq.a: Request a current payoff through the closing team and ask the servicer to reconcile the forbearance arrangement. Do not assume a statement balance answers every payoff question.

faq.q: Is a cash sale always better than keeping or listing the house?
faq.a: No. Compare available repayment help, a listing and a current-condition offer using the actual costs, equity, timing and household needs.
